text: So sorry to bother you this late, I'm probably overreacting. I'm a childminder doing an overnight and I have a little girl, 2 months old. Her temp is 37.8. I think her nappy has been dry for about 12 hours now, maybe a bit more. I've checked every change and there's been nothing wet at all. Also the soft bit on the top of her head looks like it's pushing up, sort of puffed out, not flat like it normally is? I might be wrong but it doesn't look right to me. She's got quite a sore red nappy rash too, poor thing. Her neck seems ok, she can bend her head down towards her tummy no problem, and her breathing seems normal. Sorry again, I just didn't want to sit on it
